courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 古里水壩
related.transfer: 可遷移「頻率極數與轉速」與「轉子激振頻率」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；古里水壩的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Frequency poles and speed" and "Rotor excitation frequency" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Guri Dam must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦雙頻率水電系統與跨境能量協調；古里水壩則以大型法蘭西斯轉輪更新與證據鏈為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on dual frequency hydropower and cross border energy coordination; Guri Dam centres on large Francis runner renewal and evidence chains, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「頻率極數與轉速」與「效率試驗不確定度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到古里水壩，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「疲勞循環累積」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Frequency poles and speed” and “Efficiency test uncertainty”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Guri Dam, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Fatigue cycle accumulation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 伊泰普水壩
history.text: 業主歷史記載伊泰普首部機組於一九八四年五月五日開始發電，最後兩部機組於二〇〇七年五月投入運轉。官方頻率說明指出二十部機組分成五十與六十赫茲兩組；此資料用於說明跨電網介面，不暗示兩種交流母線可以直接並聯。本課不沿用網頁中的歷史世界排名，也不把電力容量與年發電量混寫；假想的換流效率與尾水參數都另外標明，文獻年代則屬方法背景。
history.textEn: The owner history records first generation on 5 May 1984 and entry of the last two units in May 2007. Its frequency explanation divides twenty units between fifty and sixty hertz groups, establishing a grid-interface context rather than permission to parallel unlike AC buses. Historical world rankings are not repeated, nor is installed power confused with annual energy. Assumed converter efficiencies and tailwater parameters are identified separately, while reference publication dates describe methods rather than construction.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「頻率極數與轉速」到「閘門驅動功率」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Frequency poles and speed" through "Gate drive power requirement" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
